profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer at Google working in Ads Display Quality team. Before that, I was a PhD student at UC Santa Barbara working on Natural Language Processing, Deep Learning, and Social Network Analysis. 

My research interest lies in the areas of Data Mining, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Recommendation System, Social and Information Network Analysis, Web Search & Mining.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
I was a PhD student in a research group working on problems in Machine Learning and Network Science. My main projects include:

1. Finding similar questions in community question answering. 
We developed a deep attention model to capture the strong relationship between a pair of questions for better semantic similarity modeling. The model includes a bidirectional LSTM to encode contextual information followed by multi-level attention mechanism to search for parts in the source question that are relevant to the target question. Experiments conducted on Quora dataset show that the model achieves competitive results with the state-of-the-art methods.

2. Finding similar information cascade. 
The purpose is to see whether a given cascade follows the patterns of archived cascades to further understand its characteristics. We developed a model based on coupled tensor matrix factorization to learn the latent representation that best captures process similarity and network structure information. 

3. Analyzing information sharing strategies of users in online social network. 
The goal is to understand the underlying reason/strategies of users for sharing information. This work has been accepted for publication in ASONAM2016.

4. Composite network modeling (in collaboration with UIUC and IBM). 
The goal is to model the social sentiment time series data in Twitter using gas shortage time series data in Gas station network and vise versa. This work has been accepted for publication in MILCOM2014.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Member of Geo team, where I closely work with Min-yian Su to develop Deep Learning models to improve semantic location inference. My main tasks:
• Developed a number of Deep learning models and the best one currently helps boost Precision@1 inference by 0.6% (for comparison, a team of 6 full-time engineers normally sets quarterly Key results to improve the same metric by 3-4%). The developed models were launched in production that help enhance the quality of other products including Google Now and Google Photos.
• Performed deep analysis over various aspects of the developed models to design future strategies for better prediction quality.

positions.title: Research Associate Intern
positions.description:
Member of CogX team and Machine Learning theory group where I closely worked with Dr. Zhikui Wang, Dr. Florian Raudies, and Dr. Raymond Roccaforte to research on Deep Learning algorithms to design a robust Computer Vision system. My main tasks:
• Investigated theoretical foundation for a new type of network
• Explored its effectiveness, practicability, scalability and extensibility

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.description:
Member of an R&D team of 4 people to build a Q&A network for facilitating knowledge sharing in my university, and in the long term, Vietnam. It consists of 3 main components:
• ExpertRank: A custom-made ranking algorithm is built for recommending qualified responders and relevant content to users. We use Random Walker Model to model the evaluation process, Markov chain to prove its convergence, and Hadoop MapReduce distributed computing to support large-scale system.
• Search solution: A Lucene-based search engine is customized to enable people and knowledge search in our system. It includes indexing data, designing and analyzing parsers and queries, etc.
• Frameworks: Our own Ice-framework is built at server-side and Joo-framework at client-side for optimized performance, leveraging Ajax technology.

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.description:
Member of a research team on data integration towards building object-based systems including vertical search engines and social networks. My main tasks:
• Developed a distributed and automatic crawling solution to extract data objects from Facebook and HUST Student Information system.
• Identified the semantically matched objects by evaluating the similarities of their shared attributes.
• Integrated identified matched objects into a unified-schema database using the open-schema Entity-Attribute-Value model.
• Incorporated the resulting dataset into a people search engine, based on the open-source search platform SOLR.
